classification.difficultyReason: Interpret price per litre as total cost divided by volume, then perform the taught decimal-by-whole-number division and state the monetary unit rate.

content.prompt: Sharon paid $\$13.56$ to fill her lawn mower with 12 L of fuel. What was the price per litre of the fuel she purchased?

answer.worked:
Price per litre is total cost divided by litres purchased.

$$13.56\div12=\begin{array}{r}1.13\\\hline\end{array}$$

Using the division algorithm: $13\div12=1$ remainder $1$; bring down the $5$ to obtain $15\div12=1$ remainder $3$; bring down the $6$ to obtain $36\div12=3$. Keep the decimal point aligned.

The price was $\$1.13$ per litre. Check: $12\times1.13=13.56$.
